{{Top|leg}}
The '''physical boost system''' was an advanced upgrade of the [[physical boost implant]]. This device stimulated the cardiovascular and muscular systems of the body so as to provide a noticeable increase in all physical attributes, making it a valuable implant of its type.

==Behind the scenes==
In the game, the playable character must have a constitution attribute of 16 or higher.
